name: Cardano
executive_summary: Cardano's mainnet launched in 2017, built on a peer-reviewed, research-first approach to blockchain design, and nearly nine years later at the time of this scoring that shows up in its strongest category, Decentralization, which scores 64. The TradFi score of 56 is held down by thin real-world usage: annualized chain fees run around just $512,000 against a $7.5 billion market cap. The AI score of 54 is limited by a reliability incident from November 2025, when the network briefly held two conflicting versions of its transaction history at once, even though block production itself never stopped.

key_findings: Neither gate cap binds -- Regulatory Clarity Partial (65) and Security Posture Fail (70) both sit above the raw 55.51, a clean case that gate caps are ceilings, not predictions.
Set the TradFi precedent that regulatory recognition without a live spot ETF does not pass the Regulatory Clarity gate -- CME futures and a Grayscale trust exist, but no spot vehicle.
On-Chain Health (48) -- annualized chain fees near $512K against a $7.5B market cap, a weak fee-to-market-cap ratio.
Decentralization (64) is ADA's strongest structural category and cushioned the v2.0 weight realignment.
Privacy & Confidentiality (28) -- a transparent ledger with no protocol-level confidentiality. Midnight is excluded as a separate blockchain with its own token economy and a federated operator phase.

binding_cap.short_note: Capped by Deterministic Finality FAIL -- an 8-point bind, and exactly the Prototype Only ceiling.

key_findings: Economic Predictability (88) is ADA's strongest AI category -- fees are exactly calculable before submission with no bidding for inclusion, though paying more cannot accelerate inclusion at any price.
The November 21, 2025 event held two incompatible ledger states for roughly 14.5 hours while block production never stopped, tripping Operational Reliability under the finality limb.
Tier margin disclosed: 54 is the exact Prototype Only ceiling; Experimental begins at 55.

watch_items: Spot ADA ETF (GADA) eligibility opened August 9, 2026 -- a live spot vehicle would flip Regulatory Clarity to Pass, though the cap does not currently bind so the published score would not move on its own.
Peras (Q2 2027 target) would lift Deterministic Finality from Fail to Partial (not Pass), moving the AI cap from 54 to 75 -- worth roughly +6.5 points.
The Quantum Resistance gate is recorded as unverified rather than assessed; it should be resolved at the next reassessment.
